timings: Summer approx 4 AM–10 PM, winter approx 5 AM–9 PM; khidmat at dawn and afternoon; Roshni (lamp-lighting) dua before Maghrib
closures: Open all year; hours extend (approx 5 AM–1 AM) during Urs

booking.name: No booking needed for ziyarat (Dargah Committee site for info)

dress_code: Modest clothing; head must be covered for all (scarf/cap); women commonly wear saree or salwar suit
rules: Cover your head before entering the shrine
Remove footwear; wash hands and feet before entering
Expect security checks at the gates
Managed by the Dargah Committee under the Dargah Khwaja Saheb Act, 1955
best_time: October–February for pleasant weather; early morning or evening Roshni for calmer visits

festivals.name: Urs of Khwaja Gharib Nawaz
festivals.when: 1–6 Rajab (Islamic calendar); 815th Urs expected approx 11–19 Dec 2026, moon-dependent

festivals.name: Jannati Darwaza opening
festivals.when: Opened during Urs (approx 11–16 Dec 2026 per khadim sources)

reach.road: On NH-48 corridor; Jaipur approx 135 km by highway; frequent RSRTC buses
reach.local: Shrine is in the old city near Taragarh hill; lanes are narrow, so walk or take an e-rickshaw for the last stretch

tips: Kishangarh has few flights; Jaipur International (JAI) is the better-connected alternative
Avoid Urs week if you dislike huge crowds; book stays weeks ahead if you go then
Carry a scarf or cap for head covering
Buy chadar/flowers only from shops you choose; politely decline pushy touts
Combine with Pushkar (approx 15 km) and Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra nearby
notes: Daily hours come from khadim-run sites, not the Dargah Committee site. Official Urs dates depend on Rajab moon sighting. Phone/camera rules inside the shrine could not be verified from an official source. Airport km is approximate (Wikipedia: KQH is 27 km NE of Ajmer city).

timings: Western Group: sunrise–sunset daily (approx 6 AM–6 PM); ASI online slots 6–12 and 12–18
entry: ASI ticket: Indian/SAARC/BIMSTEC ₹35 online (₹40 cash), foreigners ₹550 online (₹600 cash), under-15 free. Sound & light: Indian ₹300/₹150 child, foreign ₹800/₹400

booking.name: ASI e-ticketing (circle: Jabalpur → Western Group of Temples, Khajuraho)

dress_code: No formal dress code (ASI monument); modest clothing advised as Matangeshwar next door is an active temple
rules: Carry the QR ticket plus photo ID
Only the Western Group is ticketed; Eastern and Southern groups are free
Sound & light show is a separate MP Tourism ticket bought at the venue
Do not climb on or touch the sculptures
best_time: October–March; early morning or late afternoon for the best light on the carvings

reach.road: Chhatarpur 47 km, Panna 43 km, Mahoba 55 km, Jhansi approx 175 km
reach.local: Western Group is in the village centre; walk, cycle, auto-rickshaw or taxi

avg_visit_time: 2–3 hours for the Western Group; add an evening for the show
tips: Buy tickets online for a ₹5–50 discount and to skip the counter
Sound & light shows: Oct–Feb English 6:30 PM, Hindi 7:25 PM; Mar–Sep English 7:30 PM, Hindi 8:25 PM
Hire an ASI-approved guide at the gate to understand the iconography
Summer (Apr–Jun) is very hot; start at opening time
Panna Tiger Reserve and Raneh Falls make good add-ons
notes: Kandariya Mahadeva itself is a protected monument, not an active worship temple. Airport/railway km are from Wikipedia and vary (5–8 km) across guides. ASI's own page still lists cash prices ₹40/₹600.

timings: Tue–Sun, entry 10 AM–6:30 PM (last entry); mandir darshan 10 AM–8 PM; arti 10:30 AM & 6 PM; water show after sunset (currently 7:30 PM)
entry: Complex and mandir free. Exhibitions ₹260 adult, ₹210 senior 60+, ₹160 child 4–11. Water show ₹110 adult/senior, ₹80 child. Under-4 free

booking.name: No booking for darshan; exhibition/water-show tickets at on-site counters (see official visitor info)

dress_code: Cover shoulders, chest, back and upper arms; lower wear below knees; no sleeveless/shorts. Sarong sold at ₹100
rules: No mobile phones, cameras, USB drives, smartwatches or any electronics inside
No food, drinks, pets, tobacco, alcohol or drones
Deposit banned items at the free cloakroom (switched off) before security
Metal detectors and frisking for all visitors; vehicles are searched
Photography is not allowed
best_time: October–March weekdays (Tue–Fri); arrive by early afternoon to fit in the water show

reach.road: On NH-24 / Pramukh Swami Maharaj Marg by the Yamuna; New Delhi station 11 km
reach.local: Akshardham Metro (Blue Line) is 350 m walk to Gate 1; paid visitor parking

avg_visit_time: 3–4 hours; 5–6 hours with exhibitions and water show
tips: Leave your phone at the hotel to skip the cloakroom queue (30–45 min on weekends)
Exhibition ticket window closes at 6 PM; the three halls take about 2 hours
Front rows at the water show can get wet in wind; show is in Hindi
Don't plan a Monday visit — it's closed
Vegetarian food court on site
notes: Elevation is approximate (Delhi plains on the Yamuna floodplain); not verified for the exact site. Water-show prices come from 2026 guides citing the official page; the official water-show page itself lists no price. Festival programme dates not verified on the official site.

timings: Approx 4 AM–11 PM. Bhasma Aarti 4–6 AM; Sandhya 7–7:45 PM (Chaitra–Ashwin) / 6:30–7:15 PM (Kartik–Phalgun); Shayan 10:30–11 PM
closures: Open all year; darshan pauses during each aarti
entry: General darshan free. Sheeghra (fast-track) darshan ₹250. Bhasma Aarti online booking; Tatkal ₹200 per person. Mahakal Lok corridor free

booking.name: Shri Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga official portal (Bhasma Aarti, Sheeghra Darshan, aarti, guest houses)

dress_code: General darshan: modest full-length clothes, no shorts/sleeveless. Bhasma Aarti/sanctum areas: men unstitched dhoti + sola, women saree
rules: Bhasma Aarti is online-only since 9 Apr 2026; offline free passes discontinued
Regular Bhasma Aarti booking opens 1st of the previous month, 8 AM; Tatkal opens 1 day before, 8 AM
Carry the same original photo ID used for booking
Phones, cameras, leather items and bags go in lockers before inner security
General public entry into the Garbhagriha (sanctum) is currently closed
best_time: October–March; weekday mornings are least crowded

airport.name: Devi Ahilya Bai Holkar Airport, Indore

reach.road: Indore approx 55 km via 4-lane highway; Omkareshwar approx 140 km
reach.local: Enter via Mahakal Lok (Nandi Dwar); e-carts and wheelchairs at gates; autos/e-rickshaws in town

avg_visit_time: 2–5 hours (general queue 2–5 h; Sheeghra pass much shorter)
tips: Book Bhasma Aarti only on the official portal — slots fill fast and agents are not allowed
Report well before 4 AM for Bhasma Aarti; late entry is usually denied
Carry a printout of your pass since phones go into lockers
Walk Mahakal Lok after sunset for the illuminated corridor (open approx 6 AM–10 PM)
Avoid Shravan Mondays and Mahashivratri unless prepared for 6+ hour queues
notes: Tatkal fee (₹200) is from NDTV (Apr 2026); confirm the fee shown on the portal. Bhasma Aarti dress rule details are from guides, not an official notice. Sanctum-entry status changes; check the portal before travel. Simhastha bathing dates not officially announced yet.

timings: Ram Pol gate opens at sunrise, closes 5 PM (Kartik–Magh) / 5:30 PM (Phalgun–Ashadh); Adinath prakshal puja approx 8:50–9:50 AM; evening aarti 4–4:30 PM
closures: Yatra closed during Chaturmas (monsoon): after Ashadh Sud 14 until Kartik Purnima. 2026 reopening: 24 Nov 2026

booking.name: No booking needed; dharamshalas and doli info via Seth Anandji Kalyanji Pedhi

dress_code: Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees; footwear removed at temples
rules: No one may stay on the hill overnight — not even priests; descend before evening
Do not eat or carry food on the way up
Leather items should not be carried
Climbing is not done during Chaturmas out of respect for ahimsa
best_time: November–February; start the climb at sunrise to avoid heat

festivals.name: Kartik Purnima (hill reopens; Chha Gau yatra)

reach.road: Bhavnagar 51 km, Ahmedabad approx 225 km; GSRTC buses
reach.local: Taleti (hill base) is about 2 km from Palitana station/bus stand; autos available; 200+ dharamshalas

trek.from: Jay Taleti (base of Shatrunjaya hill), Palitana
trek.notes: About 3,501 stone steps per the managing trust (often quoted as 3,500–3,750+); 2–3 hours up; rest stops and water en route; doli chairs at Taleti

avg_visit_time: Full day (5–8 hours including climb, darshan and descent)
tips: Begin the climb at dawn and carry water; there's little shade
Doli (palanquin) rates vary by season and crowd; confirm at the Taleti office
Bhavnagar has limited flights; Ahmedabad is the usual gateway
Book dharamshalas early around Kartik Purnima
Bamboo walking sticks are available at the base
notes: Coordinates are Wikipedia's for the temple complex (approx, summit area). Elevation 603 m is Wikipedia's peak figure; the trust says approx 2,000 ft. Gujarat Tourism lists 6:30 AM–6 PM hours and 3,750+ steps; trust timings used instead. Leather rule is from a secondary guide.
